Fittings part built in parts/fittings.mjs: 16 first-floor and loft window units with shutters on both faces, 12 side window units, 12 loading-door pairs (first floor, loft, gable) on both streets, lobby and keeper's double doors with transoms, six lobby glass panes, and a hanging lantern under each hoist chain.
Verified in build.nbt: every checked fitting cell holds its block (doors, transoms, panes, shutters). make.sh is whole; the part reports 304 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette.
Conflicts with the frame (P2, not yet merged) remain: shutters at x6/x8 and the gable loading doors at x11..12 / 30..31 y25..27 land on frame posts, and the lanterns float until the hoist chains exist.

waste.what: Checked which of my cells actually landed by writing a throwaway node script that reads build.nbt and prints the block at each expected coordinate
waste.cost: one script, about 30 coordinates, one rerun
waste.tool: `mcd cells build.nbt x,y,z ...` (print the block and state at given cells) or a per-part skipped list from the build library

waste.what: The parts report counts placed and refused writes, but a helper's own skips (loadingDoors atomic refusals, windowUnit footprint skips) never reach it, so a fully dropped door pair reads as success
waste.cost: had to read helper source and check cells by hand to find out what the report hid
waste.tool: runParts report should list each helper's `skipped` and atomic refusals per part, not only guarded writes

waste.what: Worked out the side-window z positions by hand against the frame post rhythm (posts every 4 on z 5..33), because the plan's z 9, 21, 29 are all post lines
waste.cost: a few minutes of arithmetic and a plan note
waste.tool: a plan.md check (`mcd plan-check` or a rule in the plan linter) that flags openings whose cells fall on another part's declared post or beam line before the parts are written

waste.what: Had to find the window bay conflict (shutters at x6 and x8 on frame posts) by reasoning about frame order, since the frame is still a stub in this copy
waste.tool: `mcd merge-preview` that runs the earlier parts' stubs and reports which of this part's cells the merged frame would refuse

companions.task: Leave the window bay posts and the gable king posts clear at the shutter cells (x 6, x 8) and at the gable door pairs (x 11..12 and x 30..31, y 25..27) so the fittings land whole; agree the bay centres for the side windows at z 11, 19, 27 instead of the plan's post lines at 9, 21, 29.
Confirm the hoist chains (x 11 and x 30 at y 26..29, z 1 and 36) that hang the two gable lanterns, since those lanterns float until the frame places them.

left: Frame conflicts (P2 merge): the shutters at x 6 and x 8 on the first-floor and loft window bays sit on frame posts; the frame places first, so those shutters will be refused. Each window pane itself lands.

Gable loading-door pairs (x 11..12 and x 30..31, y 25..27, both streets) overlap the gable king posts in the plan. loadingDoors is atomic, so a refused leaf drops the whole pair. P2 must leave these cells open, or the king posts move; I have not verified this in a merged build.
Side windows are at z 11, 19, 27 rather than the plan's z 9, 21, 29 (those are frame post lines). Noted in plan.md Notes.
Lanterns at (11,25,1), (30,25,1), (11,25,36), (30,25,36) report as floating and unsupported in mcd check, because the hoist chains they hang from are P2's hoistBeam, which is still a stub here.
Not checked after the merge: whether the frame leaves the window cells air (the middle column of each window bay and the side walls at z 11, 19, 27), which the windows depend on.
